body.name: \(\mathcal A_D\)
body.construction: Input a finite sparse or dense rational coefficient encoding of \(D\in\mathbb Q[S3]\). Using exact rational addition, multiplication, differentiation, coefficient comparison, characteristic-polynomial factorization, and rational nullspace operations, first reject zero, constant, or nonhomogeneous inputs; compare the coefficients of \(D^2\) and \(2\operatorname{tr}\{(G_DX)^2\}\), use any nonzero coefficient of \(D^2\) to force the candidate proportionality constant, and reject a nonpositive candidate or any nonzero residual coefficient. Before forming \(J_D\), guard \(D(I3)=0\) and reject with that exact witness. Otherwise form \(J_D=G_D(I3)/D(I3)\), recover integer eigenvalues, rational eigenspaces, \(a,b,e,V1,V2,\lambda_0\), and accept only after the exact coefficient check \(D-D_{\mathrm{flag}}\equiv0\). The output is \(CertD\); termination is asserted without a bit-complexity bound.
